text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer. I'll be able to run
again before
you know it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
choice_data_list: Make sure you get plenty of rest today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, after I've rested a little, do you
think I can
run again for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, after I've rested a little, do you
think I can
run again for a bit?
choice_data_list: If it gets worse, it'll be even harder to run.
Let's get that healed up quickly so you can run lots!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
choice_data_list: If it gets worse, it'll be even harder to run.
Let's get that healed up quickly so you can run lots!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... Do you think you could keep an
eye on me
so I don't go off running?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure I have... the discipline.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I respect Suzuka's request and stay by
her side in
the infirmary until nightfall.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I won't be able to run today, right?
What a
shame. It's still so bright out...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to run due to her injury, Silence
Suzuka
falls into a mental slump.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Okay. I'll get better as soon as possible,
for the
sake of running.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I want you to search for lots of
beautiful
places to go running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Silence Suzuka is burning with

determination despite her injury. I
should get to
finding new running
courses right away.
